metrics.name: Integrated circuits production
metrics.evidence_notes: Official production index, not revenue and not a count of AI components. Detailed industry series can lag the aggregate headline series. Machinery (2928) includes electronic equipment outside semiconductor lithography; networking (2729) includes non-data-center communication equipment. Packaging (2613) includes conventional packaging and testing, not advanced packaging alone.

metrics.name: Electronic components production value
metrics.evidence_notes: Broader two-digit industry aggregate. Do not label as the narrower 2611/2613 or 2711/2729 series. Nominal TWD value reflects prices and product mix as well as physical activity. Inventory is a stock at the reporting period; production and shipments are period flows. Do not sum these measures.
